summary: Post-refactor backend regression. server.py was split into core.py + per-domain routes_*.py modules. Ran full backend pytest suite (existing 78 tests) plus a new 31-test refactor smoke suite covering password login, /auth/me, logout, unauth 401 on /content, admin/member RBAC on /members, member PATCH persistence, /content GET+PUT, /files/{id} RBAC, /auth/profile PATCH, /directory alphabetical, profile-photo non-image rejection, disbursement create/list/patch/acknowledge/receipt-PDF/statement-PDF/member-scoping/cleanup, /fund /categories /audit, cron secret auth (401 no-secret, 401 bad-secret, and one manual 200 with correct secret), and stripe onboard/status/tax graceful (<500). Result: 109 passed, 0 failed (real-email-to-admin tests intentionally deselected due to provider throttling, as flagged by main agent). Route surface and behavior fully match pre-refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers. Non-blocking but worth migrating.
Full-module `from core import *` in every routes_*.py hides the actual dependency surface and risks name collisions on future edits; consider explicit imports.
core.py is ~1000 lines and still holds unrelated concerns (models, PDF, seed data, email helpers, storage, auth). Recommend a further split: models.py, pdf.py, email.py, seed.py, security.py.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New file /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_smoke.py is the canonical post-refactor regression suite (31 tests) covering all route modules created in this split. Run with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ --deselect tests/test_disbursements.py::TestResendEmail` (the deselected class hits real Resend email delivery and fails intermittently due to provider throttling — NOT a code issue). Cron manual 200-with-correct-secret was verified via curl using WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from /app/backend/.env; only performed once to avoid real emails.
